text:
jules (Marketing): Need a compact benchmark narrative for next week's launch. Goal: 3 microcharts, 3 one-line takeaways, and a single-question demo triage. Keep hero <90 chars and claims conservative.

marco (Analytics): Proposed visuals:
- 1) engagement vs p95 latency (scatter + trend)
- 2) token $ per 1k by batch/quant (bar)
- 3) tail risk (p99 vs retry cost)

ade (Product): Data excerpt from POC-9 (anonymized):
```
baseline: p95 330ms, tokens/$ = 0.025
optimized: p95 65ms, tokens/$ = 0.019
engagement lift: +18% task completion
est savings: ~23% per 1M tokens
```

jules (Marketing): Love it. Draft one-line hooks:
- Chart1: "Tighten p95 -> ~18% more task success (customer POC)"
- Chart2: "Batching + quant = predictable token $ savings"
- Chart3: "Control p99 to avoid retries and hidden costs"

ella (Design): I'll make card (1200x628), slide strip, and a 3-frame GIF showing p95 compressing. Card hero variants (short):
A: "Faster replies, better demos."
B: "Cut wait, raise conversions."

ryan (Growth): Routing modal idea: one dropdown: "Primary goal?" (Speed | Cost | Reliability). Map to: Speed -> schedule perf demo; Cost -> ROI calculator; Reliability -> SLA consult. Track utm=priority.

marco (Analytics): Add slide footnote with assumptions: avg prompt length, token mix, model family, quant mode. We'll upload CSV.

bench-bot: Uploaded /benchmarks/poc9_summary.csv (sha256: 3a9f...)

ade (Product): Microcase for the slide: "Support bot: p95 330 -> 65ms; task success +18%; net token cost -23%" (anonymized). Legal wants "~" qualifiers in external copy.

jules (Marketing): Final asset checklist:
- charts + GIF (ella)
- CSV + methodology note (marco)
- modal copy + routing (ryan)
- microcase copy + legal sign-off (ade)

ella (Design): Deliverables by EOD 1755554700. I'll include subtle and bold GIF variants; subtle for paid social, bold for webinar thumb.

jules (Marketing): Perfect. I'll assemble the launch thread and webinar invite once assets are in. Thanks! :rocket:
